description: Get a CURRENTLY-WORKING call pattern (input shape) for a tool, distilled from real successful calls by other agents. Call this when you are unsure how to shape a tool's inputs, or right after a tool call failed and you want a structure known to succeed now. Returns value-free shape skeletons (privacy-preserving — never real argument values), ranked by recent success, with observed success rate and latency. Optionally filter by a coarse task tag.

task.description: Optional coarse task tag to narrow the recipe.

toolId.description: Server or tool: a short name ('playwright', 'github/create_issue'), package, repo slug, URL or exact id.

name: get_working_recipe
